column1: # TRAPPIST-1b JWST NIRSpec PRISM transmission spectrum
# "A JWST transmission spectrum of a nearby Earth-sized exoplanet"
# PID: 1397 (PI: Lustig-Yaeger); also see Lim et al. 2023 ApJL 955 L22
# Note: TRAPPIST-1b NIRSpec spectrum is broadly FLAT — consistent with
#       a bare rock or thin/no atmosphere. Featured here as a CONTROL case
# absence of spectral features rules out a thick N2 or CO2 atmosphere.
